__broaden__.πυθέσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn, hear of; aor. inf. mid., epexegetic: αἰσχρὸν … πυθέσθαι ’a shame to hear of’ · also aor. inf. mid. + gen., after πρίν: ’(before I) learn of’ (πρίν … πυθέσθαι ’before I hear of’) · also aor. inf. mid. in tmesis with ἔκ (ἐκπυθέσθαι): ’to find out’ (ἔκ τε πυθέσθαι)

__broaden__.βαλέειν: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. inf., epic βαλέειν (= Attic βαλεῖν) · also ’strike, hit’ (ἐπευξάμενος βαλέειν ’vaunting that he had struck’)
__broaden__.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ … μάχεσθαι ’and himself to fight’) · also intensive, agreeing with a noun: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν βασιλῆα ’the king himself’) · also plain personal pronoun, direct object with no preposition: ’him’ (αὐτὸν ἐπαΐξαντες ἕλοιμεν ’rushing on, we could take him’)
__broaden__.ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’)
__broaden__.ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, over, among; prep. + acc.: ’along, across, over’ · also + dat., ’along, among’ · also ἂμ before φ, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂμ φόνον ’up through the slaughter’)
__broaden__.γίγνετ: γίγνομαι — become, arise, come to be; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (γίγνετ’ = γίγνεται): ’there is, there comes to be’ · also impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (γίγνετ’ = γίγνετο): ’came about’ (ἄραβος … γίγνετ’ ὀδόντων ’a clatter of teeth came about’)
